content_blocks.label: clause_1._GRANTOR
content_blocks.text: I, Eleanor M. Bright, of Riverdale, Novus, being of sound mind and body, make, publish, and declare this my Last Will and Testament.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_DISPOSAL_OF_ESTATE
content_blocks.text: All of my real and personal property, wherever situated, I give, devise, and bequeath to my beloved nephew, Benjamin L. Swift, of Maplewood, Novus.
